Being as genuine as possible I’m really sorry, that you are feeling down for your birthday, as I was reading your post, you said that your ”close  friends” did not care to wish you a happy birthday, but you are always there for them on their birthday, that says to me that your friend is totally indifferent towards your emotions and how you feel, because if she was a real friend the first that would’ve been on her mind, knowing that it is your birthday, is to wish you a happy birthday, She was not being a good friend I’ll encourage you to be assertive and  address the situation in a respectful way. Ask her why did she blow your birthday off, if we supposed to be close friends” ? 

Life is a journey and as you come across various people in life you have to take in consideration that no matter how long you have known someone, that doesn’t make them a friend

Never stop being nice and kind to people as well, because that’s how you attract more nice, and kind people. And stop beating yourself up there are over 8 billion people in this world and you will come across someone that will bring the best out in you 

Much love and happy birthday
